failedAssertions.reason: Pre-existing bug: showError('phoneError', ...) uses fieldId.replace('Error','') to derive input element ID, producing 'phone' instead of the actual 'storePhone'. The if-guard silently skips error display. Confirmed identical in original inline code at commit 0134aac — NOT a refactor regression.

Pre-existing bug: showError('emailError', ...) derives input ID as 'email' but actual ID is 'storeEmail'. Same root cause as VAL-FORM-004. Confirmed identical in original inline code at commit 0134aac — NOT a refactor regression.

Pre-existing bug: showError('hoursError', ...) derives input ID as 'hours' but actual ID is 'storeHours'. Same root cause as VAL-FORM-004. Confirmed identical in original inline code at commit 0134aac — NOT a refactor regression.

Pre-existing bug: showError('plusCodeError', ...) derives input ID as 'plusCode' but actual ID is 'storePlusCode'. Same root cause as VAL-FORM-004. Confirmed identical in original inline code at commit 0134aac — NOT a refactor regression.

notes: All 4 failures are pre-existing bugs in the showError/hideError helper functions that derive input element IDs incorrectly. The bug uses fieldId.replace('Error','') which strips the 'Error' suffix but doesn't map to the actual element IDs (e.g., 'phoneError' → 'phone' instead of 'storePhone'). This was verified against the original inline code at commit 0134aac and confirmed identical. The refactor (extracting inline JS to src/js/start-app.js) preserved this behavior exactly — zero behavioral changes introduced. The 29 passing assertions confirm the refactor successfully preserved all other behaviors including theme system, form structure, profile save/load, export/import, navigation transitions, Tauri fallback, and cross-area flows.
